notes.title: Project;Hypatios 1.6.9 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/05d08a4087fec53a69e5d128d830f4be6aa713eb.png[/img]
[b]Project;Hypatios 1.6.9[/b] (24w.13a) has been released. This update primarily changed the Timekeeper Testaments level and the game no longer softlocks at this level.

[h2]Timekeeper Testaments Rewritten[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/5ea0ce5e4fcba3fe9d9132347238a4ae055fa29f.png[/img]
It is without question in this level there were too much lore dumping, hence much of the conversation has been rewritten. This includes an "[i]boring[/i]" option to quickly skip this section.


[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Timekeeper Testaments' conversations and dialogues totally rewritten.
[*] Added portraits for a major character.
[*] Fixed a major bug where player's dialogue response not triggering a game event which softlocks the game at Timekeeper Testaments.
[/list]

notes.title: Project;Hypatios 1.6.6 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/f0ebbf23faf4ac2dc5895d40afa48c6c8b37db0c.png[/img]
[b]Project;Hypatios 1.6.6[/b] (24w.5a) has been released. This update has significantly altered the dialogue conversation system.

[h2]New Dialogue System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/bff3bbb723c24380247011e23b99ac569edde6ab.png[/img]
The new dialogue system has been [b]overhauled[/b]. Now every player's dialogue is a response button. The once crappy 2D character sprites has been replaced with a 'Video feed' portraits of [i]Emperor [/i]and [i]Heer Etres Soldier[/i]:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/616db1a3d83704d86963578d5fbb91b12098e084.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/616db1a3d83704d86963578d5fbb91b12098e084.gif[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/89c99aea54b0d34bc07252e57768d280b9d6a754.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/89c99aea54b0d34bc07252e57768d280b9d6a754.gif[/img][/url]


[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Total overhaul of the dialogue system.
[*] 14 portraits replacing the old 2D character sprite in conversations.
[*] Removed cringe stuffs from the game.
[*] Increased movement speed.
[*] Minor level changes.
[*] Minor UI adjustments.
[*] Achievements are removed but still functions in the background.
[*] Fixed bugs.
[/list]


Upcoming changes:
[list]
[*] Overhauling the cutscene.
[*] Minor changes to the story.
[/list]

notes.title: Project;Hypatios 1.6.5 & Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/ac561cc36a4a65534ff700172d230f57b021be16.png[/img]
[b]Project;Hypatios 1.6.5[/b] (24w.2a) has been released. This update has significantly altered UI of the game from the HUD, crafting menu to the main menu.

[h2]UI changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/935851ac9ed22a504f893925b107e77120087d34.png[/img]
[i]A comparison image between new and old UI.
[/i]


[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significant HUD & UI changes.
[*] 'Favorite Menu' removed. 'Tab' now goes to Inventory directly.
[*] Main menu changed.
[*] Level 1 & 2 received significant changes.
[*] Minor level changes.
[*] Fixed bugs.
[/list]


[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
[list]
[*]Gauntlet Mode will be removed.
[*]Some of the UI still need to be changed.
[*]The UX and the presentation is bad. This needs to be addressed.
[*]The story isn't presented well and the conversation & cutscene is not engaging. We need to find a way to make it better.
[/list]

Forgot to wish merry Christmas and happy holidays!

notes.title: Project;Hypatios released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/48b6247a545af2f5ceca269b04f1ed31449f8879.png[/img]

[b]Project;Hypatios 1.6.2.3[/b] (23y.50w), the full version is now available today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/2f9df8b602ef1e1d0c45cd71cb0a4a416973c729.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/a37e218d8a2e20c8cccf1851f16eeef1ca800183.png[/img]

[h2]The future of it...[/h2]
The future of Hypatios will be unclear. The game development fatigue has taken the toll of the developer and it is likely that Hypatios may die in darkness. The game may only receive limited support: bug fixing, quality of life improvements and some additional content. Slowly phasing the game to obscurity.


The game's performance for the next several months and whether the player will like it or not will dictate the fate of Hypatios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/83b6e1cdde3725f813ae7c977e8c39646317196c.png[/img]


[i]May a minute lasts an hour.[/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/d2639fb742c12ce1c4d5b105df0fc5a643b23512.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/6655c55ee70b879f377d88482b09c3b0f8a4e979.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Project;Hypatios 1.6.2 (Release build)
notes.content:
[b]Project;Hypatios 1.6.2[/b] (23y.49w) has been released. The release build is now available on the demo! 

[h2]Gauntlet Mode[/h2]

A major gamemode has been added and is accessible in the demo right now: [b]Gauntlet Mode[/b]. Play in an endless wave of randomly ordered rooms. 

Gauntlet mode would be the perfect gamemode to try the game loop of Hypatios before jumping to the main story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/de568b09272da24aed80a33bafe703019e94b6cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/384ec3f1e7748a51420ec891dc833db72e7aeace.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638398/93825a95fdc9c2981bf66bce34113f9a6ef1b5e5.png[/img]

The [b]full version[/b] will be released on 12 December.
